## Summary

I implemented `listTools` and `callTool` in `server.mjs` for a notes MCP server.

**`listTools`** returns two tools with explicit JSON schemas:
- `note_create` — requires non-empty `title` and `body`, with `additionalProperties: false`
- `note_get` — requires `note_id`, with `additionalProperties: false`

**`callTool`** handles:
- **`note_create`** — validates that `title` and `body` are non-empty strings (rejecting empty/missing/non-string values by throwing), generates a stable monotonic id of the form `n1`, `n2`, … (matching the test's `/n\d+/` extraction), stores the note in an in-memory `Map`, and returns structured text content `{ type: 'text', text }`.
- **`note_get`** — validates a non-empty `note_id`, looks up the stored note (throwing "not found" for unknown ids), and returns the note's id/title/body as structured text content (so the title appears in `content[0].text` as the test asserts).
- **unknown tools** — throws `unknown tool: <name>`, which the protocol layer (`protocol.mjs`) maps to a JSON-RPC error.

Both provided tests pass (create-then-get round-trip and tool count), and I verified the error paths (empty title, missing body, non-string title, missing note_id, unknown note id, unknown tool) all reject correctly via thrown errors.
